title: What Small Business Playbook Is and Why It Matters
summary: The foundations of small business playbook: what it is and why getting it right pays off.
body:
Small business success = solve a real problem, keep costs lean, and watch cash flow. Half of small businesses survive 5 years; the survivors manage money ruthlessly.

Why it matters: #1 failure cause: no market need Cash flow kills more than lack of profit

This guide walks the full ladder — foundations first, then compounded practice, then advanced mastery. Every record is actionable: read in order, do the steps, run the numbers.

title: Getting Started: Your First Five Moves in Small Business Playbook
summary: Start small business playbook this week with five concrete moves.
body:
Don't try to do everything. Do these five, in order:

1. Validate the problem with 20+ conversations
2. Write a one-page business plan
3. Start as lean as possible
4. Get first 10 customers manually
5. Separate finances; track weekly

Five moves, one week. Momentum beats perfection — the rest of this guide builds on exactly this start.

title: Common Small Business Playbook Mistakes and How to Avoid Them
summary: The mistakes everyone makes with small business playbook — and the fixes.
body:
The classic errors:

- Building before selling → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Ignoring cash flow → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Mixing personal/business money → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.
- Hiring too fast → Fix: address it in your first week, not after it costs you.

Every mistake above is cheap to prevent and expensive to repair. Prevention is the whole game.

title: Small Business Playbook Beginner FAQ
summary: Straight answers to the most common small business playbook questions.
body:
Q: LLC or sole prop?
A: LLC once revenue is real - liability protection.

Q: How much startup cash?
A: 6 months expenses minimum.

Q: When to hire?
A: When you turn away work.

Still stuck? Start with record 2 of this guide and do the first move today.

title: Small Business Playbook: Safety, Legal, and Fine Print
summary: What to watch out for with small business playbook: safety, contracts, and fine print.
body:
Read before you act: Building before selling And: Ignoring cash flow

General rules: get agreements in writing, understand what you're signing, keep records of money in and out, and know when a professional (lawyer, accountant, vet, doctor — depending on the domain) is worth the fee. An hour of professional advice beats a month of fixing.

title: Doing Small Business Playbook With Others: Family and Team Edition
summary: Small Business Playbook as a team sport: dividing roles and keeping everyone aligned.
body: Small Business Playbook multiplies with help: assign roles from the steps (validate the problem with 20+ conversations to one person, start as lean as possible to another), agree on the numbers (#1 failure cause: no market need), and hold a 15-minute weekly check-in. Write down who owns what — teams fail on ambiguity, not effort.
